name: flash
description: ST's F1 HAL programming the flash (PM0075, DS5319's times at 72 MHz on the DWT's cycle counter, the core waiting in the flash): the factory option bytes (RDP 0xA5, no write protection); HAL_FLASHEx_Erase's page in 20 ms (DS5319's minimum: it gives no typical); HAL_FLASH_Program's halfword in 52.5 us and the HAL's few cycles more (55 us), a word as two (109 us) and a doubleword as four (218 us), read back; a halfword over a programmed one refused with HAL_FLASH_ERROR_PROG (PGERR); HAL_FLASHEx_OBErase's erase and RDP's reprogramming (40 ms), Data0 programmed with its complement, and HAL_FLASH_OB_Launch's reset loading it: the second boot reads Data0 0x42 and the page as it was left.
